content.comment_body: Hello, I have been using [product_name] for over two years and recently encountered an issue where the internal clock just blinks at 00:00 and does not work, causing all my timers to fail as well. The system responds to button presses, but the timers remain inactive due to the clock not running. What could be causing this, and how can I set the clock so my timers function properly?

Welcome to the forum. Can you explain why you are unable to set the clock? Are you having trouble accessing the menu, or does the clock not respond when you try to set the time with the cursor keys? Which exact [product_name] model are you using?
It's unusual for the timers not to work. What happens if you try to set the real-time clock from your PC?
Thanks for your help. The solution worked, and the issue is resolved. I did not operate my [product_name] for over six months, and its real-time clock started blinking because it had reset.
[product_name] contains a super capacitor that keeps the real-time clock running for about 20 days without power. After that period, the clock needs to be reset when power returns.

Thanks for the welcome. On [product_name] with [version_no], I can set the real-time clock using the cursor in the menu, but with the newer version, clock setting only worked for me through [product_name] software.
You are able to set the real-time clock by using the cursor in the menu on [product_name] with [version_no] as well.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered problems with the internal real-time clock on [product_name] models, which caused timers to malfunction when the clock was stuck at 00:00 and blinking. This made automation via timers impossible until the clock was reset, showing a challenge with device usability after extended downtimes. There was also confusion between setting the clock directly on the device versus through [product_name] software, emphasizing the need for consistent and clear interfaces for clock setting functions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to easily set the internal clock using either the device menu or software so timer-based automation resumes smoothly, regardless of how long the device has been powered down.
